千總 and 把總 are two different ranks, company commander and the lower squad commander, so they should not be merged.

Among the civil and military officials and local gentry who fell at the same time were the acting brigade commander of the Quanzhou garrison, Yang Yinghe; platoon commander Bu Youxiang; grain-transport official and Sichuan district magistrate Lu Jindi; Anhui prefectural secretary Chen Yao; Hunan regimental commander Yu Yusheng; battalion commander Wu Changxian; company commanders Tian Qinghua and Ma Ruilong; platoon commanders Lu Xianzhen, Huang Zhilin, and Han Daxing; junior officers Sun Shaoquan, Yang Qingqi, Tian Hongyi, Yang Dabin, Gong Xinren, and Tian Zongnan; military licentiate Tang Dianshi; licentiates Jiang Chenglong and Jin Jianxun; military licentiate Zhang Yijing; and secretaries Huang Baibin, Zhu Yongwen, Zhu Fuping, Zhou Xiling, Sun Peiju, Yang Lingzhou, Jin Jiuju, and Zhu Ze—more than thirty in all.

Among the civil and military officials and local gentry who fell at the same time were the acting brigade commander of the Quanzhou garrison, Yang Yinghe; platoon commander Bu Youxiang; grain-transport official and Sichuan district magistrate Lu Jindi; Anhui prefectural secretary Chen Yao; Hunan regimental commander Yu Yusheng; battalion commander Wu Changxian; company commanders Tian Qinghua and Ma Ruilong; platoon commanders Lu Xianzhen, Huang Zhilin, and Han Daxing; junior officers Sun Shaoquan, Yang Qingqi, Tian Hongyi, Yang Dabin, Gong Xinren, and Tian Zongnan; military provincial graduate Tang Dianshi; licentiates Jiang Chenglong and Jin Jianxun; military licentiate Zhang Yijing; and secretaries Huang Baibin, Zhu Yongwen, Zhu Fuping, Zhou Xiling, Sun Peiju, Yang Lingzhou, Jin Jiaju, and Zhu Ze—more than thirty in all.
金家駒 is romanized Jin Jiaju, and 武舉 denotes a military provincial graduate (juren), not a licentiate.

He was enshrined together with Yanqing at Poyang, and a separate shrine to Renyuan was built at Leping. His father Yu Chi, mother née Chen, wife née Jin, younger brother Chengyuan, three sisters, concubine née Yang, and servants and women of the household were enshrined alongside him.

He was enshrined together with Yanqing at Poyang, and a separate shrine to Renyuan was built at Leping. His father Yuchi, mother née Chen, wife née Jin, younger brother Chengyuan, three sisters, concubine née Yang, and servants and women of the household were enshrined alongside him.
予墀 is the father's two-character given name (surname Li), so it should be written Yuchi rather than as if Yu were a surname.
At the same time Governor Guo Baoyin also memorialized asking for a shrine at Wuchang; an edict granted both requests.
At the same time Governor Guo Baiyin also memorialized asking for a shrine at Wuchang; an edict granted both requests.
郭柏廕 is romanized Guo Baiyin; 柏 is read bai here, not bao.
Then they again asked that his family be escorted out of the district. He said again: "That would destroy the people's hope."
Then they again asked that his family be escorted out of the district. He said again: "That would betray the people's trust in me."
是為民望也 says his staying is what the people look to; the rendering destroy the hope distorts the sense, so a closer wording is proposed.

From May through July of the sixth year rebels swarmed in; by land and water they encircled the city and assaulted it. Zaiwen, together with regimental commanders Zeng Tingxiang and Zhang Yuqing, battalion commander Tang Wencan, and others, held firm behind the walls, trapped under heavy siege for more than seventy days.

From the fifth through the seventh month of the sixth year rebels swarmed in; by land and water they encircled the city and assaulted it. Zaiwen, together with regimental commanders Zeng Tingxiang and Zhang Yuqing, battalion commander Tang Wencan, and others, held firm behind the walls, trapped under heavy siege for more than seventy days.
五月至七月 are lunar months, so they should be rendered as the fifth through seventh months rather than Western May and July.
Wencan held the south wall and led the junior clerk Zhang Ting in street fighting until both were killed.
Wencan held the south wall and led the junior officer Zhang Ting in street fighting until both were killed.
外委 is a junior military officer rank, not a clerk.

Earlier Governor Luo Chongguang had recommended Zaiwen as capable of serving at circuit or prefectural level. Vice Minister of War Wang Maoyin had also commended his outstanding reputation for upright governance. He was promoted to fill the vacant post of prefect of Guilin.

Earlier Governor Lao Chongguang had recommended Zaiwen as capable of serving at circuit or prefectural level. Vice Minister of War Wang Maoyin had also commended his outstanding reputation for upright governance. He was promoted to fill the vacant post of prefect of Guilin.
勞崇光 is romanized Lao Chongguang; 勞 is lao, not luo.

Yuan led a thousand provincial banner troops to their aid, routed the rebels at Egojing on the Yangtze in Huanggang, pursued them all the way to Anqing, and together with the Anqing garrison nearly wiped them out.

Yuan led a thousand troops of the provincial commander-in-chief's brigade to their aid, routed the rebels at Egongjing on the Yangtze in Huanggang, pursued them all the way to Anqing, and together with the Anqing garrison nearly wiped them out.
提標兵 are troops of the provincial commander-in-chief's own brigade, not banner troops, and 鵝公頸 is romanized Egongjing.
On the fifth day of the eighth month of the third year of Xianfeng—the upper day of sacrifice—Zude came out at dawn in full formal dress. Rebels swarmed into the yamen like ants.
On the fifth day of the eighth month of the third year of Xianfeng—the day of the Shangding sacrifice to Confucius—Zude came out at dawn in full formal dress. Rebels swarmed into the yamen like ants.
上丁祀事 is the Shangding sacrifice to Confucius held on the first ding day of the month, which the rendering leaves obscure.
Shang Nabubu was of the Guoluoluo clan, a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
Shangnabu was of the Guoluoluo clan, a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
尚那布 is a single Manchu personal name romanized Shangnabu; the rendering garbles it by adding a syllable.
In the tenth year of Xianfeng the rebels took Guangde. Liyang lay on its northern border, and Shang Nabubu vowed to defend the city to the last.
In the tenth year of Xianfeng the rebels took Guangde. Liyang lay on its northern border, and Shangnabu vowed to defend the city to the last.
尚那布 is a single Manchu personal name romanized Shangnabu; the rendering garbles it by adding a syllable.
Shang Nabubu shouted in a thunderous voice: "I am the magistrate of Liyang. The militia killed rebels at my order. Strike me down at once—do not harm the people!"
Shangnabu shouted in a thunderous voice: "I am the magistrate of Liyang. The militia killed rebels at my order. Strike me down at once—do not harm the people!"
尚那布 is a single Manchu personal name romanized Shangnabu; the rendering garbles it by adding a syllable.
At the same time Li Huaitong, acting magistrate of Jintan, also perished defending his city when it fell.
At the same time Li Huai, acting magistrate of Jintan, likewise perished defending his city when it fell.
The name is 李淮; the following 同 means likewise and was wrongly fused into a nonexistent name Li Huaitong.

Later the army under Taqibuy and Hu Linyi captured Tongcheng, the alarm in Pingjiang was lifted, and the army marched off on other campaigns. Then rebels swarmed in again, and Yuan'en repeatedly drove them back.

Later the army under Taqibu and Hu Linyi captured Tongcheng, the alarm in Pingjiang was lifted, and the army marched off on other campaigns. Then rebels swarmed in again, and Yuan'en repeatedly drove them back.
塔齊布 is conventionally romanized Taqibu.
He again managed Taqibuy's supply depot and soon took charge of naval camp affairs.
He again managed Taqibu's supply depot and soon took charge of naval camp affairs.
塔齊布 is conventionally romanized Taqibu.
He then joined Guofan's army at Jiujiang and was ordered to manage Luo Zemin's supply depot.
He then joined Guofan's army at Jiujiang and was ordered to manage Luo Zenan's supply depot.
羅澤南 is romanized Luo Zenan; 南 is nan, not min.

In the third month of the sixth year Li Yuandu led his army south from Hukou. Yuan'en and Deng Fuzun marched east from Nanchang. The two armies met at Fuzhou, captured Jinxian and Dongxiang, advanced and broke five strong fortifications at Wenchang Bridge, and burned out their strongholds.

In the third month of the sixth year Li Yuandu led his army south from Hukou. Yuan'en and Deng Fulun marched east from Nanchang. The two armies met at Fuzhou, captured Jinxian and Dongxiang, advanced and broke five strong fortifications at Wenchang Bridge, and burned out their strongholds.
鄧輔綸 is romanized Deng Fulun; 綸 is lun, not zun.
Then Fuzun fell victim to slander and withdrew. Many of those in the field resigned. Yuan'en's position grew ever more isolated, and supplies daily ran short.
Then Fulun fell victim to slander and withdrew. Many of those in the field resigned. Yuan'en's position grew ever more isolated, and supplies daily ran short.
輔綸 is romanized Fulun; 綸 is lun, not zun.

In the eleventh month he also acted in command of the land army at the foot of Mount Lu and south of Gufang. The Jiangxi governor, hearing that Yuan'en was a man of talent, sent an urgent dispatch to Nanchang entrusting him with the newly recruited Pingjiang Battalion.

In the eleventh month he also acted in command of the land army at the foot of Mount Lu and south of Gutang. The Jiangxi governor, hearing that Yuan'en was a man of talent, sent an urgent dispatch to Nanchang entrusting him with the newly recruited Pingjiang Battalion.
姑塘 is romanized Gutang, a place on Poyang Lake.
Calmly he removed a gold ingot and handed it to a nephew, saying: "You ride off. I and Master Lin will die here!"
Calmly he removed his gold bracelet and handed it to a nephew, saying: "You ride off. I and Master Lin will die here!"
金條脫 is a gold armlet or bracelet, not an ingot.
Following Grand Coordinator Deng Shaoliang he held firm for more than eighty days and destroyed several thousand rebels.
Following provincial military commander Deng Shaoliang he held firm for more than eighty days and destroyed several thousand rebels.
提督 is a provincial military commander; grand coordinator translates 巡撫.

At first he won repeated victories. Then rebels with three thousand men besieged the south gate. Dayu, together with his younger cousin, candidate vice prefect Rong Qing, joined in a combined attack. The rebels arrived in force. Their strength failed and both died.

At first he won repeated victories. Then rebels with three thousand men besieged the south gate. Dayu, together with his nephew, candidate vice prefect Rongqing, joined in a combined attack. The rebels arrived in force. Their strength failed and both died.
胞侄 is a brother's son, i.e. a nephew, not a younger cousin, and 榮清 is a single given name.
After more than a month they crossed Linming Pass. Governor-General Nayanceng fled with his army, and the rebels passed through Sunhe, Baixiang, and Luancheng into Shenzhou.
After more than a month they crossed Linming Pass. Governor-General Na'erjing'e fled with his army, and the rebels passed through Shunhe, Baixiang, and Luancheng into Shenzhou.
納爾經額 is romanized Na'erjing'e, and 順河 is Shunhe; the rendering garbles both.
The rebel chieftain Kaishan Wang Xiao Tuzi commanded under a yellow flag. Swift, fierce, and agile, he could leap more than a zhang in one bound and dodge musket fire.
The rebel chieftain Xiao Tuzi, styled the Mountain-Opening King, commanded under a yellow flag. Swift, fierce, and agile, he could leap more than a zhang in one bound and dodge musket fire.
開山王 is a rebel title meaning Mountain-Opening King, not part of the personal name.
Militia squad leaders Yu Penglong and others fell in battle one after another. Again the heads taken were beyond counting, and the rebels fled.
Militia squad leaders Yu Penglong and others charged into the enemy lines one after another. Again the heads taken were beyond counting, and the rebels fled.
陷陣 means to break into the enemy formation, not to fall in battle.
Penglong, together with his adopted son Chen Liang and others, all died fighting.
Penglong, together with his nephew Chen Liang and others, all died fighting.
從子 means a nephew, not an adopted son.
Earlier, when the rebels passed Linming Pass, Vice Prefect Zhou Xian sat in official robes on a supply wagon and cursed the rebels until they killed him.
Earlier, when the rebels passed Linming Pass, Vice Prefect Zhou Xianzeng sat in official robes on a supply wagon and cursed the rebels until they killed him.
The name is 周憲曾; 曾 is the last character of the name, not a separate word, so the name was truncated.

When the rebels entered the district he, together with acting battalion commander Pan Zongde and others, captured and beheaded the rebel Sima Chen Dewang. Then a large force swarmed in. Government troops were outnumbered and suddenly broke and fled.

When the rebels entered the district he, together with acting battalion commander Pan Zongde and others, captured and beheaded the rebel sima Chen Dewang, a bogus rebel rank,. Then a large force swarmed in. Government troops were outnumbered and suddenly broke and fled.
偽司馬 is a rebel rank title, not part of the personal name.
When Luancheng fell, Tang Sheng in court robes cursed the rebels. They bound him to a pillar and killed him. Subprefect Chen Huchen died with him.
When Luancheng fell, Tang Sheng in court robes cursed the rebels. They bound him to a pillar and killed him. Jail warden Chen Huchen died with him.
典史 is a county jail warden, not a subprefect.

Before long the rebels arrived in force. He cut off half a sleeve and sent a servant galloping to inform his parents. Then, seal in hand, he mounted the wall and calmly showed the seal to subprefect Xu Fengjie.

Before long the rebels arrived in force. He cut off half a sleeve and sent a servant galloping to inform his parents. Then, seal in hand, he mounted the wall and calmly showed the seal to jail warden Xu Fengjie.
典史 is a county jail warden, not a subprefect.
Subprefect Qu Jun, courtesy name Juping, was a native of Wujin in Jiangsu.
Jail warden Qu Jun, courtesy name Juping, was a native of Wujin in Jiangsu.
典史 is a county jail warden, not a subprefect.
Wen Ying, courtesy name Luqi, of the Zhao clan, was a Han bannerman of the Plain Blue Banner.
Wen Ying, courtesy name Luzhai, of the Zhao clan, was a Han bannerman of the Plain Blue Banner.
魯齋 is romanized Luzhai; 齋 is zhai, not qi.
He captured the bandits Fu Minnan, Wushi Jie, and others, earning a reputation for ability.
He captured the bandits Fu Minnan, Wushizi, and others, earning a reputation for ability.
烏石姊 is romanized Wushizi; 姊 is zi, not jie.
He was promoted to assistant prefect of Guangzhou Prefecture and transferred to serve as assistant magistrate of Haifeng.
He was promoted to registrar of Guangzhou Prefecture and transferred to serve as assistant magistrate of Haifeng.
府經歷 is a prefectural registrar, not an assistant prefect.

In the second year of Xianfeng, Hong Xiuquan captured Renhua and Lechang counties and sent a detachment against Ruyuan. Fen recruited three hundred braves, arranged with regional commander Che Dinghai to hold the river in defense, and had local militia circle around the riverbank to set an ambush.

In the second year of Xianfeng, Hong Xiuquan captured Renhua and Lechang counties and sent a detachment against Ruyuan. Fen recruited three hundred braves, arranged with battalion commander Che Dinghai to hold the river in defense, and had local militia circle around the riverbank to set an ambush.
都司 is a battalion commander; a regional commander is 總兵.

Tizhen and Guard Army commander Shu Baoshan had just been invited into the city to defend together and had barely dismounted when bandits poured in through a breach. Tizhen led militia in street fighting. Outnumbered, he took ten wounds from blade, spear, and musket alike and died shouting to kill bandits.

At Tizhen's request Guard Army commander Shubao had just entered the city to defend it with him and had barely dismounted when bandits poured in through a breach. Tizhen led militia in street fighting. Outnumbered, he took ten wounds from blade, spear, and musket alike and died shouting to kill bandits.
The commander is 舒保 (Shubao); the following 善因 was wrongly fused into a nonexistent name Shu Baoshan, and 因請入城同守 means he entered at Tizhen's request.
De Kedenge, courtesy name Jing'an, was a Bannerman of a certain Manchu banner.
Dekedeng'e, courtesy name Jing'an, was a Bannerman of a certain Manchu banner.
德克登額 is a single Manchu name romanized Dekedeng'e, not a surname De plus a given name.
After crossing four mountain passes, bandits swarmed forth.
After crossing Sidao Ridge, bandits swarmed forth.
四道嶺 is a place name, Sidao Ridge, not four passes.
The county bordered western Guangdong. Cantonese unrest pressed close, and local bandits took advantage.
The county bordered Guangxi. Cantonese unrest pressed close, and local bandits took advantage.
粵西 is the standard name for Guangxi province, not the western part of Guangdong.
He was dispatched to Guizhou as a prefectural assistant and was soon recommended for magistrate.
He was dispatched to Guizhou as a prefectural registrar and was soon recommended for magistrate.
府經歷 is a prefectural registrar.

Lingyun was determined to govern well. He toured his jurisdiction week by week, shook hands with old farmers in the fields and asked about their hardships and needs, jotting notes in a small book. By this means he exposed hidden grievances, and litigants regarded him with awe.

Lingyun was determined to govern well. He toured his jurisdiction in a full circuit, shook hands with old farmers in the fields and asked about their hardships and needs, jotting notes in a small book. By this means he exposed hidden grievances, and litigants regarded him with awe.
週巡 means to tour all around, not week by week.
Tuokiqing'a, courtesy name Ningru, was a Manchu bannerman of the Plain Blue Banner.
Tuokeqing'a, courtesy name Ningru, was a Manchu bannerman of the Plain Blue Banner.
托克清阿 is a Manchu name romanized Tuokeqing'a; the rendering drops the e of 克.
Governor Le Bin also noted his bold competence and appointed him acting magistrate of Qinzhou; he soon received full appointment.
Governor-General Lebin also noted his bold competence and appointed him acting magistrate of Qinzhou; he soon received full appointment.
總督 is a governor-general, and 樂斌 is a single Manchu name, Lebin.
Governor En Lin relayed the request to the throne, and a special edict approved it, granting the posthumous name Ganglie, 'Firm and Fierce.'
Governor-General Enlin relayed the request to the throne, and a special edict approved it, granting the posthumous name Ganglie, 'Firm and Fierce.'
總督 is a governor-general, and 恩麟 is a single Manchu name, Enlin.
In the first year of Xianfeng the Jintian rebels fled east from Wuxuan. General Uriangga, Regional Commander Xiang Rong, and Brigade Commander Qin Dingsan pursued them step by step.

In the first year of Xianfeng the Jintian rebels fled east from Wuxuan. Lieutenant-General Wulantai, Provincial Military Commander Xiang Rong, and Regional Commander Qin Dingsan pursued them step by step.
烏蘭泰 is Wulantai, not Uriangga; 都統 is a lieutenant-general, 提督 a provincial military commander, and 總兵 a regional commander.
When Regional Commander Xiaoshun's troops reached Maoping and were surrounded, Baokun led militia following Brigade Commander Tong Panmei in relief, and the siege was lifted.
When Provincial Military Commander Xiaoshun's troops reached Maoping and were surrounded, Baokun led militia following Regional Commander Tong Panmei in relief, and the siege was lifted.
提督 is a provincial military commander and 總兵 is a regional commander.
Governor Jiang Yunyuan ordered the Yunnan defector general Chen Degong to follow Xiaoshun in recapturing Duyun and advancing to relieve Mahe, and government forces regained momentum.
Governor Jiang Weiyuan ordered the Yunnan defector general Chen Degong to follow Xiaoshun in recapturing Duyun and advancing to relieve Mahe, and government forces regained momentum.
霨 is read wei, so 蔣霨遠 is Jiang Weiyuan.
In the fourth month the religious rebel Yang Zhangxi raided into Mahe. He followed Prefect He Ting in driving them back.
In the fourth month the religious rebel Yang Longxi raided into Mahe. He followed Prefect He Ting in driving them back.
漋 is read long, so 楊漋喜 is Yang Longxi.

Before his advice could be acted on, the rebels crossed Long from Guyuan Pass. Local Muslims at Zhangjiachuan and Lianhuacheng rose in response, Yan Cha and Guyuan fell, Jin Yong was killed, and Pingliang was placed under martial alert.

Before his advice could be acted on, the rebels crossed Long from Guyuan Pass. Local Muslims at Zhangjiachuan and Lianhuacheng rose in response, Yancha and Guyuan fell, Wan Jinyong was killed, and Pingliang was placed under martial alert.
鹽茶 is the place name Yancha, and 金鏞 is the given name of Wan Jinyong, not a separate person.
From clerical service he was recommended as county archivist and dispatched to Anhui.
From clerical service he was recommended as jail warden and dispatched to Anhui.
典史 is the county jail warden, not an archivist.
In the second year of Xianfeng he served as acting archivist of Huaining County. He showed compassion to prisoners and often said: "Prisoners may die by law — that is acceptable;
In the second year of Xianfeng he served as acting jail warden of Huaining County. He showed compassion to prisoners and often said: "Prisoners may die by law — that is acceptable;
典史 is the county jail warden, not an archivist.
At that time there was also Zhang Baohua, archivist of Wangjiang County.
At that time there was also Zhang Baohua, jail warden of Wangjiang County.
典史 is the county jail warden, not an archivist.

Wang Si, patrol inspector of Huayang town, died at the same time. Zhou Laiyu, archivist of Xuyi County, later in the ninth year helped defend the county seat, fought with all his strength, fell from his horse, and died.

Wang Si, patrol inspector of Huayang town, died at the same time. Zhou Laiyu, jail warden of Xuyi County, later in the ninth year helped defend the county seat, fought with all his strength, fell from his horse, and died.
典史 is the county jail warden, not an archivist.

In the sixth year Governor-General Mutu Shan memorialized the circumstances of Rukui's death and requested mourning honors under the precedent for death in battle. He was posthumously granted the rank of National University assistant instructor, awarded a hereditary office, and a shrine was ordered in his native place with his wife, daughter, and others who died with him enshrined there.

In the sixth year Governor-General Mutushan memorialized the circumstances of Rukui's death and requested mourning honors under the precedent for death in battle. He was posthumously granted the rank of National University assistant instructor, awarded a hereditary office, and a shrine was ordered in his native place with his wife, daughter, and others who died with him enshrined there.
穆圖善 is a single Manchu name, Mutushan, not a surname Mutu plus given name Shan.
